name: STRANDED
source:
Michael Bester is the last survivor on a planet many light-years from Earth. His monotonous existence is shaken when a mysterious second survivor appears in the facility.

[From [url=https://jyagger.itch.io/stranded]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迈克尔·贝斯特是距地球数光年之外的一颗行星上的最后幸存者。当一名神秘的第二名幸存者出现在设施中时，他单调的存在受到了动摇。

[来自[url=https://jyagger.itch.io/stranded]Itch.io[/url]]
